description: This file declares the CompositionManager class responsible for managing display composition, overlays, and frame blending in a WebRTC-related environment within the cuttlefish project. It includes methods for handling display events, frame processing, and overlay parsing.

classes.name: CompositionManager
classes.description: Manages display overlays, frame composition, and blending for WebRTC video streams within the cuttlefish environment.

classes.name: CompositionManager::DisplayOverlay
classes.description: Represents overlay configuration for a display, including source VM and display indices.

classes.name: CompositionManager::LastFrameInfo
classes.description: Stores information about the last frame processed for a specific display, including pixel data and format.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of CompositionManager.

methods.name: OnFrame
methods.description: Processes incoming video frames for a specific display.

methods.name: ComposeFrame
methods.description: Performs composition of a frame with overlays and blending.
